integrity: Proof uses the absolute-trace Artin--Schreier obstruction and an explicit four-root classification; exact field enumerations corroborate, rather than prove, the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Only the zero-output-relative-trace fiber for the e=4, q=2^s subfamily is classified. No claim for full permutation status when s is not congruent to 3 modulo 4. Broader implicit literature coverage and independent validation remain unresolved.
title: A mod-four trace-fiber obstruction for a recent reversed-Dickson permutation question
